channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Entenda o julgamento de Eduardo Bolsonaro no STF que começa nesta terça-feira
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF begins ruling this Tuesday on the criminal case against former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, accused of acting in the United States to pressure Brazilian authorities and influence the progress of investigations related to the post-2022 election coup attempt. The case involves allegations of obstruction of justice and attempts to interfere with probes into the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Ala do STF se prepara para atuar como revisora do TSE nas eleições, e Kassio tenta marcar posição
item.description: A group of STF ministers is preparing to act as a reviewing body for TSE decisions in the 2026 elections, creating friction with Kassio Nunes Marques' leadership. The move aims to counterbalance electoral court rulings, as Kassio seeks to position himself amid the institutional crisis.

item.title: STF começa a julgar Eduardo Bolsonaro sob risco de novo atrito com EUA
item.description: The STF begins the criminal trial against Eduardo Bolsonaro, accused of acting in the U.S. to intimidate the Brazilian Judiciary. The First Chamber has a tendency to convict the lawmaker, which could spark a new diplomatic rift with the United States.

item.title: Campanha de Lula prioriza regulamentação das redes em vez de proibição para menores de 16 anos
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign prioritizes regulating social media for users under 16, choosing to assess the impact of the newly implemented ECA Digital before proposing new measures. The strategy avoids direct bans in favor of evidence-based regulatory solutions. This reflects a cautious, technical approach to addressing youth digital environment concerns.

item.title: Lula declara apoio a João Campos ao governo de Pernambuco
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared his support for former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) in the 2026 Pernambuco gubernatorial election, ruling out a dual slate with incumbent governor Raquel Lyra (PSD). The announcement was made in a video shared by Campos on social media, following a conversation with PT national president Edinho Silva, who rejected the idea of two slates in the state. Minister Wellington Dias had previously suggested a dual slate, which upset Campos.

item.title: Lula apoiará adversário de pai de Motta ao Senado pela Paraíba
item.description: President Lula declared his support for the re-election of Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo (MDB-PB) for the Senate in Paraíba, emphasizing their long-standing and honest partnership. He ruled out supporting Nabor Wanderley (Republicanos), father of Chamber President Hugo Motta, despite earlier expectations. Nabor’s office denied any withdrawal, stating he remains a strong pre-candidate.

item.title: Frente parlamentar e delegados repudiam fala de Lula sobre delegacias e celulares roubados
item.description: The Parliamentary Front for Public Security and the Adepol repudiated President Lula's statements regarding police station safety and the association of stolen phone buyers with low-income populations, calling them unjust generalizations and prejudiced remarks that undermine trust in law enforcement institutions.

item.title: Fachin mantém decisão de Dino, e Roraima segue com candidato único
item.description: Supreme Court President Luiz Edson Fachin denied the PL's request to suspend Justice Flávio Dino's decision reinstating the requirement for public officials to resign 3, 4, or 6 months before running in Roraima's supplementary elections. As a result, interim governor Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) remains the only viable candidate, while Boa Vista mayor Arthur Henrique (PL-RR) and Antônia Pedrosa (PT-RR) are barred for failing to resign in time. The ruling upholds STF precedent that the Court president cannot overturn another minister's injunction and that only the Public Prosecutor or public entities may seek suspension with proven public interest.

item.title: Fachin nega recurso do PL e mantém decisão de Dino sobre eleição em RR
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin denied a PL appeal and upheld Minister Flávio Dino's ruling that set deadlines for disengagement from public office ahead of the Roraima gubernatorial election in a caretaker term. The decision maintains the requirement for candidates to resign from public positions before the 2026 election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro 'perdeu a condição de poder ganhar a eleição de Lula', diz Ronaldo Caiado sobre disputa pela Presidência
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has lost the condition to defeat Lula (PT) in a potential runoff, citing polls showing declining support for the senator. He positioned himself as the candidate with the best chance to beat Lula, noting that his own poll numbers show either a tie or within the margin of error, while Flávio Bolsonaro trails significantly. Caiado also refused to pre-judge Flávio Bolsonaro’s ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, insisting that individuals must answer for their own actions.

item.title: Novo-SC desconvida Zema de encontro estadual e ameaça se opor à candidatura
item.description: The Santa Catarina state directory of the Novo Party withdrew the invitation to presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema for the party's 7th State Meeting, scheduled for July 4 in Joinville. The decision followed Zema's criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro's association with banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating it would be difficult to applaud someone who associates with 'Brazil's biggest criminal banker'. The directory threatened to oppose Zema's candidacy unless there is a 'drastic and immediate change' in his campaign's communications team.

item.title: Lula pede reeleição de Veneziano, rival do pai de Hugo Motta ao Senado
item.description: President Lula recorded a video endorsing the re-election of Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo (MDB-PB) for the Senate in the 2026 elections, citing his honest and committed relationship with the government. Veneziano is the main rival of Nabor Wanderley (Republicanos), mayor of Patos and father of House Speaker Hugo Motta, who is also seen as a potential Senate candidate for Paraíba. Despite Lula’s support for Veneziano, Nabor Wanderley’s team stated the endorsement was anticipated and does not change their commitment to maintaining his candidacy.

item.title: Associações policiais criticam declaração de Lula sobre delegacias
item.description: Police associations criticized President Lula's statement claiming Brazilians avoid returning stolen phones to police stations due to fear of treatment, suggesting instead that returns be made at post offices. Entities like Sindesp and Adepol argued that civil police play a fundamental role in criminal investigations and property recovery, calling the remarks unfounded and damaging to officers' credibility. The controversy extended to Congress, where the head of the Public Security Parliamentary Front accused Lula of casting unjustified suspicion on police forces.

item.title: Flávio lança Hélio Lopes como pré-candidato ao Senado por Roraima
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro announced federal deputy Hélio Lopes as the pre-candidate for the Senate from Roraima in the 2026 elections. In a social media video, Flávio emphasized Hélio's loyalty to Bolsonarism and the family's confidence in his candidacy.

item.title: Reforço para Trump e Eduardo Bolsonaro contra Alexandre de Moraes: a Justiça italiana
item.description: Italy's justice system denied the extradition of former deputy Carla Zambelli, bolstering attacks by Eduardo Bolsonaro and Donald Trump against STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Eduardo urged Trump and U.S. officials Rubio and Bessent to sanction Moraes, calling the STF a 'political tribunal' and Moraes a 'human rights violator,' while Brazil's AGU defends Moraes in U.S. courts, asserting that STF rulings cannot be challenged in foreign tribunals.

item.title: “O meu partido e eu estamos apoiando o João Campos”, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) released a video declaring his support for former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) in the Pernambuco gubernatorial race, aiming to dispel doubts about a potential split ticket in the state. He explicitly stated: 'My party and I are supporting João Campos'.

item.title: MP do Frete prevê anistia a caminhoneiros condenados por bloqueios
item.description: The rapporteur of Provisional Measure 1.343/2026, Deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC), included in the report an amnesty for truckers and transporters punished for highway blockades after the 2022 elections, annulling fines, ending ongoing proceedings, and suspending definitive convictions. The measure was labeled a 'jabuti' by government allies for being unrelated to the MP's main topic of freight pricing. Trovão also removed the proposed fine of up to R$10 million for non-compliance with the freight floor, replacing it with a proportional mechanism based on the difference between paid freight and the ANTT-set minimum, multiplied by two.

item.title: Justiça revoga prisão e arquiva processo contra jornalista perseguido por Zambelli
item.description: São Paulo's justice system revoked the arrest order against journalist Luan Araújo and dismissed the case after he paid the R$ 2,216.30 fine related to a defamation conviction against former congresswoman Carla Zambelli. The arrest had been issued due to non-payment, but his defense argued financial hardship and public support to reverse the decision. The case stemmed from Luan's article describing being chased by an armed Zambelli in October 2022, an incident that had already led to her STF conviction for illegal firearm possession and illegal coercion.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro sugere rompimento do PL com o partido Novo após críticas de Zema a Flávio
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro suggested a complete break in alliances between the PL and the New Party following criticisms by Novo’s pre-candidate Romeu Zema against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stemming from leaked conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The statement was made in defense of Flávio Bolsonaro, whom Eduardo claims was unfairly attacked by Zema.

item.title: Sancionado marco do transporte público com novas regras de financiamento
item.description: Law 15.432/26 has been sanctioned, establishing a new legal framework for urban public transportation in Brazil, emphasizing diversified funding sources, performance-based operator remuneration, and enhanced transparency. The law strengthens the integration of urban planning and transport, sets minimum service quality standards for regularity, safety, accessibility, and environmental impact, and mandates public disclosure of operational data to strengthen social oversight. Presidential vetoes removed provisions that would have created unfunded budgetary obligations, such as mandatory funding of fare subsidies and the use of carbon credits as a financing mechanism.

item.title: Lula amplia vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro em simulação de segundo turno, diz Nexus
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro in a simulated runoff with 49% voting intention, compared to 43% for the PL senator, according to the BTG/Nexus poll. The president’s advantage has widened since previous surveys, indicating stronger consolidation of his electoral base.

item.title: Bolsa Família é intocável, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that the Bolsa Família program has become an acquired right of the Brazilian people and that no one has the right to touch or end it. He made the remarks at the VEJA Fórum Rumos do Brasil in São Paulo, emphasizing the program's inviolability as a social benefit.

item.title: Em meio a boatos, Lula diz que apoio a João Campos é ‘compromisso histórico’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that his support for João Campos (PSB) as gubernatorial candidate in Pernambuco is a 'historic commitment', emphasizing the long-standing alliance between the PT and PSB, including his ties to Miguel Arraes and Eduardo Campos. The remark was made in a video shared by Campos on social media, amid rumors that Lula might back two slates in the state — one for Campos and another for Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD). Lula did not confirm or deny the possibility of dual support but reiterated that his backing of Campos is genuine and rooted in a productive relationship.

item.title: Lula grava vídeo em apoio a João Campos após ex-prefeito reclamar de palanque duplo em Pernambuco
item.description: Lula recorded a video endorsing João Campos (PSB) for governor of Pernambuco after Campos objected to reports of a potential double endorsement involving Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD). The president publicly denied supporting both candidates, reaffirming his exclusive backing for Campos and citing the PSB’s historical legacy, including figures like Miguel Arraes and Eduardo Campos. The video was shared by Campos on social media, as the PT treats the Pernambuco race as a top national priority, warning that divided support could jeopardize PT-PSB alliances in other states.

item.title: Lula declara apoio a adversário do pai de Hugo Motta ao senado na Paraíba
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) declared his support for the re-election of Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo (MDB-PB), who is running against Nabor Wanderley (Republicanos-PB), the father of Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta, in the Senate race for Paraíba. Lula’s endorsement strengthens the PT-MDB alliance in the state, countering Republicanos’ backing of the opposition candidate. The contest highlights regional political tensions with national implications.

item.title: Novo desconvida Zema de evento em SC depois de críticas a Flávio
item.description: The Santa Catarina chapter of the Novo party withdrew an invitation for presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema to attend a July 4 event in Joinville following his criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, aiming to maintain internal alignment around uniting the right against the PT. Despite the snub, Zema reiterated his support for Flávio in a potential runoff against Lula and said he hopes to return to the state soon.

item.title: Relatório da MP do Frete reduz multas e anistia caminhoneiros
item.description: Deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC) presented the final report of the Minimum Freight MP, which reduces fines for non-compliance with the ANTT freight table, abolishing the fixed fine of up to R$10 million and replacing it with payment of double the difference between the amount paid and the regulated floor. The report also grants amnesty to truckers involved in post-2022 election protests, converts penalties into warnings, and relaxes RNTRC suspension rules. It increases the mandatory hiring quota for autonomous truckers from 14% to at least 30%.

item.title: Governo apresentará texto para atualizar limites do MEI, diz ministro
item.description: The Minister of Entrepreneurship, Paulo Pereira, announced that the federal government is preparing a proposal to update the MEI limits, with the annual gross revenue ceiling currently frozen at R$ 81,000 for years. The initiative aims to modernize MEI rules, aligning with PLP 108/2021, which proposes raising the limit to R$ 130,000 and allowing up to two employees. President Lula has directed the search for a solution, and the proposal is expected to be sent to Congress in the coming days.

item.title: “Esse negócio de eleição presidencial é bobagem”, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) said he does not regret choosing to remain in charge of the state instead of running for president, calling the presidential election "nonsense". He made the remark during an event in São José dos Campos, in the interior of São Paulo, on Monday, the 15th.

item.title: Romário nega ter criticado Fernanda Gentil em comentário na “CazéTV”
item.description: Romário denied criticizing Fernanda Gentil, stating she is one of the 10 people who know football best in Brazil, and said his CazéTV comment was misinterpreted. He clarified that only those unfamiliar with football would see the Morocco draw as a defeat, while reaffirming his respect for Gentil, saying she speaks the truth when she speaks. Gentil added she did not take the comment as offensive, explaining Romário did not question her football knowledge but merely disagreed with her assessment of the draw.

item.title: Ciro tem 53,2% e Elmano, 44,9%, em eventual 2º turno no CE, diz pesquisa
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB) leads Elmano de Freitas (PT) by 8.3 percentage points (53.2% to 44.9%) in a hypothetical runoff for governor of Ceará, according to an AtlasIntel/Focus poll released June 15, 2026. In the simulated first round, the candidates are technically tied (45.8% to 44.8%), within the 3-point margin of error. The survey interviewed 1,223 voters from June 9–14, is registered with the TSE (CE-03465/2026), and cost R$75,000.

item.title: Flávio confia em ‘virada’ após a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that the 2026 electoral landscape will still undergo significant changes after the World Cup, despite recent polls showing a decline in his performance relative to President Lula (PT). He expressed confidence in a 'turnaround' in his electoral numbers following the tournament. The remarks were made during his participation in the Veja Fórum in São Paulo.

item.title: Zema é desconvidado de evento do Novo em Santa Catarina após criticar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, was uninvited to a party event in Santa Catarina after criticizing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged ties to jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro. The state directory of Novo stated the invitation was withdrawn unilaterally and warned it would oppose Zema's candidacy unless his communication team changes immediately. Despite the rift with Bolsonarist allies, Zema affirmed the right should unite in a potential runoff against the PT.

item.title: Eleições 2026: CNC é a 1ª instituição do Terceiro Setor a inspecionar códigos-fonte dos sistemas eleitorais
item.description: The National Confederation of Commerce of Goods, Services and Tourism (CNC) conducted on Monday (15) the first inspection of electoral system source code for the 2026 General Elections by a Third Sector institution. The visit took place at the headquarters of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) in Brasília, as part of a marathon of audits aimed at increasing transparency and participation of legitimate institutions in electoral oversight. Access to the source code was opened by the TSE in October 2025, following prior inspections by the Federal Senate and the Brazil Union party.

item.title: Tarcísio nega arrependimento de não concorrer à Presidência: "Bobagem"
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas denied regretting not running for president, calling the idea 'nonsense'. He emphasized his commitment to São Paulo and stated his decision was based on consistency with his long-term goals. The governor also said he spoke with Jair Bolsonaro about a potential candidacy but chose to remain in state leadership.

item.title: Às vésperas de julgamento por coação, Eduardo Bolsonaro volta a pedir sanções dos EUA contra Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro urged the U.S. government to reimpose sanctions on Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, one day before his trial for coercion in the course of proceedings. He claimed the STF is preparing to convict him in retaliation against former President Donald Trump and argued that his efforts to engage U.S. officials should not be criminalized. The trial is scheduled for June 16, 2026, before the First Chamber of the STF, composed of Justices Flávio Dino, Cármen Lúcia, Cristiano Zanin, and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen quer entender eleitor de Trump
item.description: Bruce Springsteen said he wants to find 'common ground' with a portion of his audience that distanced itself from him due to his political stances, particularly regarding Trump voters. He made the comment at the 2026 Tribeca Film Festival while receiving the Harry Belafonte Voices for Social Justice Award. Springsteen aims to reconnect with fans who felt alienated by his activism.

item.title: Renan surfa eleitor 'nem-nem' que Caiado e Zema esnobaram
item.description: Renan emerges as an alternative for 'neither-nor' voters (neither Bolsonaro supporters nor Lula supporters) who were overlooked by former governors Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) and Romeu Zema (Novo-MG), who are trying to inherit Jair Bolsonaro's legacy without attracting this segment. While Caiado and Zema focus on appealing to the far right, Renan gains traction by addressing more moderate and pragmatic demands.

item.title: Nordeste e eleitores 40+ veem segurança pública como principal problema do país
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll reveals that public safety is the top concern for Brazilians in the 2026 elections, particularly among voters over 40 and residents of the Northeast. This issue is consolidating as a central theme in the electoral debate, surpassing other demands in these specific groups.

item.title: No Rio, Zema minimiza fala de Eduardo Bolsonaro sobre rompimento com o Novo e reafirma críticas a Flávio
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for President, downplayed Eduardo Bolsonaro's claim of a 'general rupture' between the PL and Novo, stating the parties remain allied in several states. He reiterated his criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's association with banker Daniel Vorcaro, calling him a 'bandit banker' and saying he never met with him. Zema added that the right will unite in a potential runoff against Lula, regardless of internal conflicts.

item.title: Condenação de Eduardo dói na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The likely conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro by the Federal Supreme Court is negatively impacting the campaign of his brother, Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running for governor of Rio de Janeiro in 2026. A Quaest poll released on Monday shows that Eduardo’s verdict could harm Flávio’s image through association, despite no direct involvement in the alleged crimes. The question is no longer whether Eduardo will be convicted, but the severity of the sentence and its electoral consequences.

item.title: Para Girão, revelações sobre caso Master têm impacto de 'hecatombe política'
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) stated that revelations about the Banco Master scandal have the impact of a 'political hecatomb', criticizing the delay in Daniel Vorcaro's plea bargain and accusing the Senate presidency of blocking a CPI. He also accused several STF ministers of conflicts of interest, except André Mendonça, whom he praised for his technical approach.

item.title: Zema é desconvidado de evento do Novo em SC
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for president under the Novo party, was uninvited from a Novo party event in Santa Catarina scheduled for July. The decision followed a public suggestion by former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro distance himself from Zema, amid criticisms made by the former governor. The incident highlights internal tensions between Bolsonaro allies and the Novo party regarding Zema’s political stance.

item.title: Moraes não é só vítima e juiz, mas também investigador, acusador e, às vezes, carcereiro
item.description: The text argues that Alexandre de Moraes holds conflicting roles in Brazil’s judicial system — as victim, investigator, accuser, judge, and sometimes jailer — raising concerns about impartiality, particularly in cases like Carla Zambelli’s extradition. It alleges his STF office informally requested reports from the TSE to justify pre-decided measures, involving aide Eduardo Tagliaferro, and notes that Italy’s Court of Cassation did not acquit Zambelli but rejected extradition due to objective concerns about Moraes’s impartiality.

item.title: Desconvite a Zema pelo Novo em SC desagrada sigla em MG: "Desrespeito"
item.description: Minas Gerais Novo Party president Christopher Laguna criticized Santa Catarina's Novo branch for withdrawing an invitation to former governor and presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema, calling the move discourteous and unrepresentative of the national party. He attributed the decision to pro-Bolsonaro pressure within SC's directory, despite Zema's criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro. The SC directory defended the move as necessary to unite the right against Lula's re-election.

item.title: Presidente da bancada da bala apresenta moção de repúdio a Lula
item.description: Federal Deputy Alberto Fraga (PL-DF), president of the Parliamentary Front for Public Security, introduced a motion of repudiation against President Lula in the Chamber's Committee on Public Security and Combating Organized Crime, claiming Lula offended low-income populations. The move reflects ongoing tensions between the 'bancada da bala' and the federal government.

item.title: Daniella Marques vai integrar núcleo econômico de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Economist Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal and former member of Paulo Guedes’ team in the Bolsonaro government, has been named part of the economic and social mobility core of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) presidential pre-campaign. The announcement was made at the Veja-promoted Fórum Rumos do Brasil in São Paulo, where Flávio praised her expertise and trustworthiness, particularly in economic inclusion and female entrepreneurship. Daniella confirmed her participation on social media, stating she accepted the role despite personal sacrifices, believing in a larger mission for Brazil’s future.

item.title: Zema é 'desconvidado' de evento do Novo em Santa Catarina após atritos do mineiro com o bolsonarismo
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, was uninvited from a party event in Santa Catarina after publicly criticizing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. The decision was made by Novo’s pre-candidates and mayors in SC, despite the PL-Novo alliance in the state. Zema said he wishes to return to the state and stands by his past criticisms, though he avoided new remarks on the matter.

item.title: O BRASIL COMEMORA A MAIOR DERROTA QUE LULA SOFRERÁ NAS ELEIÇÕES 2026 E A ESQUERDA SE DESESPERA.
item.description: The text suggests Brazil is preparing to celebrate an alleged major defeat that Lula will suffer in the 2026 elections, indicating a crisis scenario for the left. The content appears sensationalist and based on misinformation, featuring YouTube video elements without substantive information. No verifiable facts or concrete proposals are presented.

item.title: Pesquisa inédita aponta que 7 em cada 10 brasileiros estão fora dos extremos políticos
item.description: A FESPSP study finds that 69% of Brazilians lack a 'love and hate' bond with political poles, showing growing indifference as the dominant sentiment. While ideological polarization rose from 19% in 2006 to 31% today, voters tend to reject opponents before positively aligning with any camp, with a 16-point drop in positive adhesion without hostility. Coordinator Jairo Pimentel warns that this cold or disenchanted relationship with politics weakens democratic representation.
